jobs.occupation: HR Operations Specialist, Berlin (m/w/d) (Automobil-Fachwirt/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

As part of the HR Operations organization, the HR Operations Specialist will deliver first line support and day-to-day direction to the complete HR team in EMEA or other stakeholders.  The HR Operations Specialist is the first point of contact for our employees and they will respond to employee inquiries, by providing support, advice, problem solving, identifying solutions and escalates as needed. This position requires good judgment and extreme initiative and is accountable for the quality and productivity of requests.  The HR Operations team acts as a bridge between employees and other departments e.g. Payroll, Benefits, Finance, HR Partners, etc. 

What You’ll Do

- First point of contact for our employees for all their inquiries and concerns; providing guidance, advice, problem-solving and coaching throughout their employee experience at Tesla 
- Manage and process HR transactions (including onboarding, transfers, reorganizations, new hires, terminations, job and personal data changes, organizational changes, employee verifications, etc.)
- Explaining human resources policies, procedures, laws, and standards to new and existing employees 
- Timely response to any incoming requests; email, open visiting hours as per agreed SLA’s 
- Effective administration of employee documentation throughout their Tesla journey including, but not limited to; contract management, leave management, job changes 
- Ensure operational processes, procedures and policies are properly documented, kept up to date and uploaded to the applicable systems  
- Responsible for the integrity of employee master data entered in our HR Management systems and maintaining personnel files, while ensuring we are compliant with GDPR 

What You’ll Bring

- HR Administration/HR Operations experience is a plus; ideally in a customer-facing environment 
- Working knowledge of HRIS, E-Ticketing tools and absence management systems  
- Basic knowledge of local laws, regulations, employment law guidelines and policies 
- Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken German and English (minimum C1)
- Must be extremely organized and detail-oriented with the ability to handle multiple tasks or shift priorities as needed in a fast-changing environment 
- Proven skill at handling stressful issues and interfacing with all levels of the business in a courteous and professional manner 
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite; especially Excel

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Design Engineer, Sealing (m/w/d) Berlin Germany (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

As a Closures Sealing Engineer, you will work with some of the industry’s brightest minds and take engineering ownership of complete static and dynamic sealing systems as well as Daylight Opening trims for Tesla vehicles. Your work will focus on static and dynamic seals for current vehicle programs, with an emphasis on quality improvement, cost reduction, and manufacturing enhancements. Additionally, you will be responsible for the engineering and design of static and dynamic seals and DLO trims for future vehicle programs.   Your ownership of seals will include initiating and overseeing both virtual (CAE) and physical testing and analysis to validate new designs from concept to production. This role provides a great opportunity to interface with all aspects of vehicle development. You will work closely with the body, closures, electrical/firmware, exterior, and interior teams, as well as with manufacturing engineering, to establish world-class seal and trim designs along with world-class assembly processes.  

What You’ll Do

- Serve as a member of the Vehicle Engineering Team, supporting closure system static and dynamic sealing and DLO trim development for Tesla vehicles  
- Fully specify elastomeric seal designs through the creation of specification drawings 
- Initiate seal CAE studies, interpret results, and iterate until geometry and materials meet design targets 
- Select appropriate materials for elastomeric static and dynamic seals and DLO trims 
- Understand manufacturing processes used to produce elastomeric seals, TP & metallic trims, and assembly processes 
- Achieve innovation-driven closure sealing & trims system targets for appearance, function, quality, cost, and weight 
- Establish system level architecture and functionality based on market research, design feasibility and prototyping. Creation of component specifications, and other technical design documents 
- Participate in the iterative process with the Tesla design and styling studio to deliver the optimal balance of form, function, and quality 
- Interpret/develop Tolerance Analysis, CAE, DFM, DFMEA, PFMEA simulations/results and integrate feedback into product designs 
- Manage and collaborate with key suppliers (both internal and external) to support overall vehicle development milestones and prototype/ production build events 

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience, with evidence of exceptional ability 
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in the design and engineering of static/dynamic seals and exterior trims 
- Strong understanding of GD&T 
- Ability to interpret FEA results and integrate recommendations into product designs 
- Experience designing new and improved seals and trim components using design software 
- Proficiency in CAD software V5/3DX for designing 2D sections and 3D geometry of seals. Experience designing complex seal molds is a plus 
- Proven track record of ownership of seal and trim designs from concept (new or improved) through production 
- Experience collaborating with supply chain partners in the development of new seals and trims 
- Must be proactive in improving processes and driving projects—examples of such initiatives should be provided 
- Excellent communication skills, resourcefulness, and time management Please apply with your CV in English.

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

jobs.occupation: Expert Project Planning & Scheduling (m/f/d) (Projektingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

The first 8 weeks of any given project are considered the most critical and crucial for the initialization of the project and the successful execution of the same. To help the BUs and the RAs organizations, it has been decided to create a new group that will be mainly focused on executing the project setup, ensuring the needed infrastructures, software, systems, procedures and tools are correctly implemented to guarantee a consistent and structured project delivery approach, in line with contractual requirements and Client's expectations.
The Expert Project Planning & Scheduling (m/f/d) is expected to initiate the project planning and contribute to its successful execution. This includes preparing, monitoring, and ensuring compliance with all planning and scheduling requirements to meet client expectations and contractual obligations.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Prepare project planning and scheduling tools and track the delivery of key inputs.
- Implement all tools in accordance with corporate requirements (mandatory tools) and ensure a corporate-compliant planning and scheduling setup, including the project master schedule and the progress measurement system.
- Align planning and scheduling systems with the company's information requirements (e.g., SAP).
- Develop all necessary documentation and procedures for the implementation of the aforementioned tools and systems.
- Ensure that the planning systems are set up according to the standardized WBS structure and are configured to exchange data with oneERP.

Show your expertise

- Master's degree in Engineering, Economics, or Project Management, coupled with several years of relevant operational experience in the construction industry.
- Demonstrated in-depth knowledge of project planning and the proven ability to analyze technical documents effectively.
- Skilled in introducing new methodologies and techniques in planning, with a strong track record of working collaboratively with internal teams and external consultants.
- Proven experience in ensuring all planning systems align with company information requirements like SAP and are set up according to standardized WBS structures, enhancing data exchange with systems such as oneERP.
- Fluent in English with German being a significant plus. You also exhibit strong verbal and written communication skills and proactive behavior, essential for successful team and client interactions.

What we offer you

- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through eGym Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany

Contact:

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

jobs.occupation: Senior Automation Expert (f/m/d) IT/OT Security Platforms (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:

Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As an Automation Engineer (f/m/d) for IT/OT Security Platforms, you will play a key role in building, automating, and operating the technical foundation of these strategic services. You will work closely with service managers, solution architects, operations teams, and factories worldwide to deliver scalable, automated, and secure solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and industrial digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.
What we offer you

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .

What part will you play?

- You design, implement, and maintain automation solutions for IT/OT Security Platforms (specifically but not exclusively SINEC Secure Connect, ensuring secure, scalable, and reliable service operations).- You develop and operate Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using modern automation frameworks and support the automated deployment of platforms and services across Siemens factory environments.- You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, operational tooling, and automation workflows to improve service delivery, reduce manual effort, and increase operational efficiency.- You integrate platforms, tools, and services through APIs and automation frameworks to enable seamless operational processes and data flows.- You support the implementation and operation of Zero Trust connectivity solutions and contribute to the automation of policy management, provisioning, and operational workflows.- You collaborate with factories and project teams to integrate solutions into existing IT and OT environments while considering operational requirements and brownfield infrastructures.- You support troubleshooting, monitoring, and continuous service improvement activities and help ensure stable operations across global deployments.- You evaluate and leverage modern technologies such as AI-driven automation, analytics, and operational intelligence to continuously improve platform operations and deployment processes.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.

What you bring to the table

- You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Automation, or a comparable qualification.- You possess strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code and Platform Automation, including Terraform, Open Tofu, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, scripting, and automated deployment of connectivity and operations platforms (at least 3+ years of experience).- Scripting/programming skills with Python/Bash/Go.- Proven hands-on experience with Cloud (AWS) and containerized environments and microservices like Docker (at least 2+ years of experience).- You have experience with AI-driven DevOps, Operations and Automation, including the use of LLMs, GitHub Copilot, AIOps concepts, workflow automation, and analytics-driven operational improvements. - You bring hands-on experience in OpenZiti Development (optional) and API Integration (mandatory), including SDKs, REST APIs, policy automation, and custom tooling to integrate Zero Trust networking capabilities into applications and operational workflows. (1+ years of experience).- You have a solid understanding of OT Infrastructure and Industrial Protocols, including PLCs, HMIs, OPC UA, PROFINET, machine-to-machine communication, OT troubleshooting, and the secure integration of solutions into brownfield factory environments. You also understand the emerging role of AI agents in OT environments and the underlying connectivity, security, and operational requirements they introduce.- You possess knowledge of Cybersecurity, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, Active Directory, Single Sign-On (at least 1+ year of experience).- You are able to bridge IT and OT requirements and collaborate effectively with architects, factory engineers, operations teams, and business stakeholders.- You are passionate about automation, standardization, and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on reducing manual effort through scalable technical solutions.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

jobs.occupation: Senior Negotiation Consultant (f/m/d) (Einkäufer/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Senior Negotiation Lead in the Corporate Strategic Procurement Department at Siemens Energy, you will play a crucial role in shaping and executing high-stakes negotiation strategies that drive value for the company. You will be the go-to expert for complex negotiations, providing both hands-on and strategic guidance to transform settings and outcomes. Each day, you will engage in impactful negotiations, optimize supplier agreements, and enhance procurement processes. Your expertise will directly influence our corporate procurement strategies, contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of reimagining energy for a sustainable world. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and execute negotiation strategies for complex supplier negotiations, driving cost optimization, cost recovery, risk mitigation, and improved commercial terms
* Lead critical supplier negotiations and provide strategic advice to Procurement leaders on objectives, trade-offs, escalation strategies, and outcomes
* Further develop the negotiation competence hub by establishing consistent negotiation standards, methodologies, and best practices
* Build negotiation capabilities across the organization through coaching, training, and knowledge sharing
* Translate negotiation outcomes and lessons learned into enhanced commodity, supplier, and procurement strategies
* Drive digital innovation and continuous improvement across the negotiation lifecycle, fostering a strong negotiation mindset and culture of excellence

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or MBA is a plus.
* Extensive professional experience in strategic procurement and/or commercial negotiations, with a proven track record in complex, high-stakes environments
* Deep knowledge of negotiation principles and advanced methodologies, combined with strong commercial acumen and excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills.
* Outstanding communication, influencing, and advisory skills, with the ability to effectively challenge and engage senior stakeholders.
* Strong coaching and collaboration skills, with proven ability to build effective cross-functional and international networks and manage multiple priorities.
* Passion for digitalization and innovation, with experience in digital procurement and negotiation tools; fluency in English, with additional languages as an advantage.

About the Team

Our global Special Projects and Transformation team is part of Siemens Energy’s Corporate Commodity  Management organization. We partner with Procurement teams and businesses worldwide to deliver strategic  initiatives, strengthen capabilities, and transform how Procurement creates value.  You will join a collaborative and forward - looking team where diverse perspectives, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:

As a

Maintenance Engineer (m/f/d)
, you’ll work in our soon to open Fulfilment Center in Berlin/Brandenburg (Falkensee) with the latest intralogistics systems from top brands like Apollo, Qimarox, and Regal Rexnord. Well-being & Balance: Professional mental health support via OpenUp.

jobs.description:

Job description

In order to support our Doors & Cabin Interiors Department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

Leader Multifunctional Team (d/f/m) for Transparencies

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.

- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Development of Strategic Sourcing Strategies (PSS) for the dedicated Commodities
- Position holder has to ensure that procurement for Serial and Spare parts is secured in cooperation with Operative Procurement.
- Position holder shall ensure that all Repair and Service demands for the various Programs are being met in cooperation with Operative Procurement.
- Fully responsible for Price and Contractual negotiations within the given mandate.
- Negotiation of Development-, Production Investment-, Frame- and Service Level Contracts within the given mandate.
- Cooperation with dedicated interface departments within the scope of Development Projects and supplier Selection.
- Cooperation with dedicated interface departments within the scope of Supplier Evaluation (SED process).
- Responsible for ensuring the fulfillment of the Eurocopter Quality Standards which have to be met by the Supplier and the delivered Materials in cooperation with the dedicated interface departments
- Continuous surveillance of the dedicated Procurement Market.

- Responsible to clarify inaccuracies in invoices in cooperation with accounting department.
- Responsible to solve delivery shortages and quality problems in cooperation with the dedicated interface department and the Supplier Support of the Departments: Quality, Disposition, Offset, Obsolesence, Export Control and Customs
- Maintenance of SAP data.

Strategic Tasks:

- Development of Strategic Sourcing Strategies (PSS) for the relevant Commodities.
- Position holder has to issue Request for Proposals according to the needs of the Programs and conduct the analysis in cooperation with dedicated interface departments until Supplier Selection is done.
- Responsible for the Contractualization of required Parts and Services in accordance with the Sourcing Strategy and under consideration of the dedicated Program needs and demands.
- Analysis and evaluation (Risks and Opportunities) of the Supply Markets
- Conduction of Price- and Value Analysis for Conduction of Supplier Evaluation and Development initiatives

- Experience in Management of international Selection- and Development Projects for flying products of aircrafts.
- Good Expertise in: Commercial-, Financial-, Contractual- and Project Management.
- Good understanding of the development process for aeronautical systems.
- Practical experience in the implementation of the quality process required in the aeronautical industry.
- High level of Communication Skills and Social Behavior.
- Experience in working with international Partners and Teams.
- Experience in Conflict Management.
- Strong Team Player.
- Negotiation level in English required Knowledge in French and German are beneficial.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now !
